around in Lisp by default. So if it's going to happen, I plan to try 
documenting it. We simply can't have these obscure features that work like
magic and which are passed by word of mouth ... Any seconds on ALAN's motion
for flushing 2nd arg to *FUNCTION? Any discussion?
